subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 06, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 06, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

We hope this newsletter finds you well. As we continue to work on making AcreetionOS the best Arch-based Linux distribution for our users, we want to keep you updated on the latest developments.

Firstly, we would like to acknowledge the recent security updates issued by AlmaLinux. These updates address several vulnerabilities, including those affecting dpdk, httpd:2.4, kernel, kernel-rt, mysql:8.0, php:7.4, php:8.0, qt5, ruby:2.7, ruby:3.0, tesseract, webkit2gtk3, and xorg-x11-server. We recommend that all users update their systems to ensure the latest security patches are applied.

In other news, a critical security vulnerability has been discovered in OpenSSH on Alpine Linux systems. A workaround has been released in version 10.6p2, and we advise users to update their OpenSSH installations as soon as possible.

On the development front, we have been working on various tasks to improve the overall user experience. Our latest commits include intelligence sync updates, fixes for postinstall.sh, and improvements to the AcreetionOS-Carousel-Wallpapers repository. We also made some changes to the release.yml file in acreetionos-immutable to fix a workflow validation issue.

We are committed to providing a secure and stable distribution, and we appreciate your continued support. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server or through our GitLab instance.

In related news, we would like to remind you that our community is always here to help. If you need assistance with any aspect of AcreetionOS, feel free to ask, and we will do our best to assist you.

As we move forward, we will continue to work on new features and improvements. We are excited about the future of AcreetionOS and look forward to sharing our progress with you.

In the meantime, we would like to thank you for being part of our community. Your support means the world to us, and we are grateful for your enthusiasm and dedication to our project.

If you have any feedback or suggestions, please don't hesitate to share them with us. We value your input and look forward to hearing from you.

Thank you for choosing AcreetionOS, and we wish you a great day.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva and Darren Clift
